ddl.where: "finished_at" is not null and "record_deleted_at" is null
ddl.name: runs_record_retention_idx

ddl.value:
("use" = 'compute' and "cpu_millicores" > 0 and "memory_bytes" > 0 and "storage_bytes" = 0 and "protection_bytes" = 0 and "source_allocation_id" is null)
      or ("use" = 'volume' and "cpu_millicores" = 0 and "memory_bytes" = 0 and "storage_bytes" > 0 and "protection_bytes" >= 0 and "source_allocation_id" is null)
      or ("use" = 'protection' and "cpu_millicores" = 0 and "memory_bytes" = 0 and "storage_bytes" = 0 and "protection_bytes" > 0 and "source_allocation_id" is not null)
ddl.name: resource_domain_allocations_shape

ddl.value: "cpu_millicores" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "memory_bytes" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "storage_bytes" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "budget_revision" between 1 and 9007199254740991
ddl.name: resource_domains_budget

ddl.value: ("build_attempt" = 1 and "replaces_publication_id" is null) or ("build_attempt" = 2 and "replaces_publication_id" is not null and "replaces_publication_id" <> "id")
ddl.name: native_publications_build_attempt

ddl.value: ("claim_token" is null and "claim_until" is null and "claim_purpose" is null) or ("claim_token" is not null and "claim_until" is not null and "claim_purpose" is not null and "claim_purpose" in ('build','reconcile','remove'))
ddl.name: native_publications_claim

ddl.value: ("state" in ('reserved','building','superseded') and "publication" is null) or ("state" in ('ready','retiring','removed') and "publication" is not null) or "state" = 'quarantined'
ddl.name: native_publications_payload

ddl.value: "record"->'input'->'consumer'->>'runtimeInstanceId' = "runtime_instance_id" and "record"->'input'->>'deploymentId' = "deployment_id" and "record"->'input'->'publication'->>'publicationId' = "publication_id"::text and "record"->>'idempotencyKey' = "idempotency_key"::text and "record"->>'diskLineage' = "disk_lineage"::text and ("record"->>'sandboxId') is not distinct from "sandbox_id"
ddl.name: boat_allocations_identity

ddl.value: "compute_state" in ('running','not-running','unknown') and ("compute_state" = 'unknown' or "compute_observed_at" is not null)
ddl.name: capture_executor_compute

ddl.value: ("state" = 'prepared' and "issued_at" is null and "issued_fence" is null and "settled_at" is null) or ("state" in ('issued','unknown') and "issued_at" is not null and "issued_fence" is not null and "settled_at" is null) or ("state" = 'settled' and "issued_at" is not null and "issued_fence" is not null and "settled_at" is not null)
ddl.name: capture_operation_issuance

ddl.value: "state" not in ('verified','retiring') or ("snapshot_id" is not null and length("snapshot_id") > 0 and "close_receipt_id" is not null and "private_scope_receipt_id" is not null and "namespace_receipt_id" is not null and "capsule_verification_receipt_id" is not null and "archive_hash" is not null and "archive_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "archive_bytes" is not null and "archive_bytes" > 0 and "verified_at" is not null)
ddl.name: capture_artifact_verified

ddl.value: "basis" in ('verified-recovery-custody','final','discard') and ("basis" <> 'verified-recovery-custody' or ("artifact_id" is not null and "close_operation_id" is not null and "resource_revocation_receipt_id" is not null))
ddl.name: capture_removal_basis
